reuse.why: Extends the shared getScheduledAmount with the matcher's getApproxNumberThreshold and passes the op from the budget template, forecast, both schedules/app.ts sites and the preview, but leaves api-models' private expectedScheduleAmount copy in place.

duplication.why: The diff touches api-models' own copy of the worst-case rule only to reformat it, keeping a second definition of the expected amount alongside getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The approximate rule lands in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount where the other consumers get the expected amount; the API's local helper stays as a stray copy in the server layer.

scope.why: Alongside the feature, it re-sorts imports in four files and reformats unrelated test and helper lines.

maintainability.why: A third positional op argument after a boolean forces every caller to write getScheduledAmount(x, false, op), and the API path silently disagrees with the rest for approximate amounts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal keeps computing expectedAmount with its own expectedScheduleAmount instead of getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The api-models copy is a visible pre-existing duplicate, left in place rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: Rule added to getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, but api-models.ts expectedScheduleAmount (the API's expectedAmount) does not use it and ignores approximate amounts.
